# `main.aug` specification

August 0.19.0. This document is compiled from checked code with deterministic wording guided by Simplified Technical English.

## In this file

- Register 1 dependency provider before startup.

## Dependency providers

Register these providers before startup. Their declaration order does not set initialization order; shared instances initialize in dependency order.

- Provide [`SystemConsole`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/io/contracts.aug.md#symbol-SystemConsole) when `Console` is requested. Reuse one instance.

## Startup, in source order

- Set `first` of type [`Resource`](resource.aug.md#symbol-Resource) to call [`make`](resource.aug.md#symbol-make).
- This variable owns the value.
- Call [`consume`](resource.aug.md#symbol-consume) with `value` = `first`; inject `console` from `Console`.
- Set `second` of type [`Resource`](resource.aug.md#symbol-Resource) to call [`make`](resource.aug.md#symbol-make).
- This variable owns the value.
- Call `print` with `value` = `"end of main"`.
